# CMUdict fixture notice

The pronunciation records in this directory are from CMUdict, Copyright
(C) 1993–2015 Carnegie Mellon University. The Carnegie Mellon Speech Group and
many volunteers contributed to the dictionary.

The immutable source revision and extraction procedure are recorded in
`SOURCE.json`; the upstream BSD-style license is reproduced exactly in
`LICENSE.txt`. The corpus pronunciations are stored separately from this
project’s force-spelling policy. That policy is a g2p-mix regression
expectation, not a claim about CMUdict’s annotations.
